newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine February trade deficit $134 million.
newsitem.headline: Argentine February trade deficit $134 million.

text.p: Argentina's trade deficit rose to $134 million in February from $102 million in February 1996, the Economy Ministry said Tuesday.
February's trade figure compared with a deficit of $472 million in January.
February's exports totaled $1.87 billion, up from $1.42 billion last February and $1.84 this January. Imports were $2.0 billion in February, up from $1.52 last February and $2.31 billion in January.
"These two months have had the highest level of exports in Argentine history," Industry Secretary Alieto Guadagni said.
Exports rose by 29 percent in January and February compared with the same period in 1996. Exports within the Mercosur customs union rose 21 percent to $1.2 billion.
Exports to the European Union fell 10 percent to $616 million. Exports to North American Free Trade Agreement members rose by 16 percent to $327 million.
